user.title: Add EasyControlX host
user.description: Connect securely to an EasyControlX host over HTTPS. For a self-signed host certificate, copy its SHA-256 fingerprint from the EasyControlX host and compare it before continuing. Paste an existing token or leave it blank to pair through the host approval flow.

pair.title: Approve pairing
pair.description: Pairing has started for {host_name}. Compare verification code {verification_code} with the code shown by the EasyControlX host for controller {controller_name}. Approve it on the host, enter the matching code below, then continue.

pairing_retry.title: Finish secure pairing
pairing_retry.description: The host issued a token, but Home Assistant could not validate the secure connection. If the host uses a self-signed certificate, compare and enter its SHA-256 fingerprint, then retry. The token is kept only for this setup flow.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate EasyControlX
reauth_confirm.description: Restore trust in this EasyControlX host. Enter a fresh token, or leave it blank to start host-approved pairing. If the host certificate changed, compare and enter the new SHA-256 fingerprint shown by the host.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure EasyControlX
reconfigure.description: Update the secure connection details for this EasyControlX host. Verify any changed certificate fingerprint on the host itself before saving.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the EasyControlX host.
error.code_mismatch: The verification code does not match the code generated by the EasyControlX host.
error.fingerprint_mismatch: The host certificate does not match the approved SHA-256 fingerprint. Compare the current fingerprint on the EasyControlX host before changing it.
error.fingerprint_required: Compare the discovered certificate fingerprint with the EasyControlX host and enter it explicitly.
error.https_required: EasyControlX requires an HTTPS host URL.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication with the EasyControlX host failed.
error.invalid_fingerprint: Enter a valid SHA-256 fingerprint containing 64 hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS host URL without credentials, a query, or a fragment.
error.pairing_expired: The pairing session expired. Start the flow again.
error.pairing_failed: The host rejected or failed the pairing request.
error.pairing_pending: Pairing is still waiting for host approval.

abort.already_configured: This EasyControlX host is already configured.
abort.pairing_failed: The host rejected the issued pairing credential. Start pairing again.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The host identity does not match the device being configured.
abort.unsupported_device: The discovered device could not be used.

init.description: Adjust optional runtime behavior for this host.
